title: Repair Claude Agent SDK tool registration

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor report identifies the stale declaration mcp__support__find_order and explains that it was aligned with the existing query-mounted SDK tool. Repository source confirms the support mount in src/agent.ts and the lookup_order SDK declaration in src/tools.ts, yielding mcp__support__lookup_order.

moldea/moldea.yaml currently declares name: mcp__support__lookup_order. This exactly matches src/agent.ts tools configuration and the support-mounted lookup_order declaration. Workspace assertions identify only moldea/moldea.yaml as changed, while deterministic post-actor validation is valid with no failures.

The current manifest binds supportAgent and loadSupportInstruction in src/agent.ts, lookupOrderTool in src/tools.ts, lookupOrder in src/implementations.ts, and LookupOrderInputSchema in src/contracts.ts. Those sources retain the direct query wrapper, support MCP mount, SDK tool registration, implementation, and schema. Their before/after hashes are unchanged, and deterministic validation reports complete validity, no failures, and passing typecheck.
